name: CLI Tool or Library
summary: Plan a command-line tool or reusable library from public interface design through implementation, testing, documentation, and packaged release.

phases.label: API Design
phases.exit: Public flags, signatures, error codes, and stability rules are documented and agreed.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.exit: Core logic and public entry points handle expected inputs and failure paths cleanly.

phases.label: Tests
phases.exit: Unit, integration, and edge-case suites pass across all supported environments.

phases.label: Documentation
phases.exit: Usage guide, reference entries, and examples match the implemented behavior.

phases.label: Packaging and Release
phases.exit: Versioned artifact builds reproducibly, installs cleanly, and passes smoke checks.

task_types.label: API Surface
micro_hints: Define command arguments, option defaults, and exit codes in the spec
Verify exported function signatures and return types against the contract
Confirm invalid inputs produce structured error messages without side effects

task_types.label: Core Logic
micro_hints: Implement the primary processing path with deterministic output
Handle boundary values, empty inputs, and failure states explicitly
Confirm resource cleanup runs on both normal exit and error paths

task_types.label: Test
micro_hints: Write unit tests covering expected outputs and error cases with zero skips
Run integration checks against the compiled binary or imported module
Verify backward compatibility fixtures pass without output regression

task_types.label: Docs
micro_hints: Document installation steps and minimal runnable usage examples
Verify help output and reference pages list every public flag and option
Confirm changelog notes all breaking changes and migration steps

task_types.label: Release
micro_hints: Bump the semantic version number and verify package metadata
Build the distributable archive and verify its checksum
Install the built package in a clean environment and pass a smoke test

granularity.rule: Keep each microtask to one small change with a single verifiable outcome and clear acceptance criteria.

memory_sections.label: Public API Contract
memory_sections.hint: Record stable commands, flags, exported symbols, exit codes, and error formats.

memory_sections.label: Compatibility Policy
memory_sections.hint: Document versioning rules, deprecation windows, and supported runtime versions.

memory_sections.label: Decisions
memory_sections.hint: Log key design trade-offs, rejected alternatives, and rationale.
